import { defineTable, col, pgEnum } from "@rebasepro/server/schema";

const nwrEnum = pgEnum("nwr_enum", ["Node", "Way", "Relation"]);

// ⚠ Not reproduced exactly by `rebase db push` — read before pushing:
//   - the foreign key relation_members_id_fkey spans (relation_id, version); a relation holds one column, so its columns are plain columns.
//   - "member_role" is a varchar with no length, declared as text: a push would convert it to text, which keeps every value.
export const relationMembers = defineTable("relation_members", {
    columns: {
        relationId: col.bigint({ mode: "number" }).primaryKey(),
        memberType: nwrEnum().notNull(),
        memberId: col.bigint({ mode: "number" }).notNull(),
        memberRole: col.text().notNull(),
        version: col.bigint({ mode: "number" }).primaryKey().default(0),
        sequenceId: col.integer().primaryKey().default(0)
    },
    rls: "admin-only"
});
